statement: The service was terminated after the image-processing path caused sustained process memory growth.

confidence.rationale: The original runtime series and an independent reproduction support the same causal chain.

predictedObservations: Repeated image uploads should cause monotonic process memory growth in an isolated reproduction.
falsificationCriteria: The same request sequence completes with stable memory after disabling the suspected image-processing path.
missingEvidence: A heap snapshot from the original process was not available.

validations.rationale: An isolated reproduction showed memory growth only when the suspected path was enabled.
